decisions.reason: NL1 requires DoorShut to remain in DoorShut on Cancel and to go to DoorOpen on door opened. The inspection_equivalent_facts transition inventory for state:DoorShut:line:50 shows only DoorShut -> DoorOpen on Door_Opened and no DoorShut -> DoorShut edge.
